Suggested actions: (1) Acknowledge the complaint immediately, as it came by direct message, with a reference number and an indicative resolution time-frame. (2) Retrieve the consent record for this service, including opt-in and 2FA/OTP evidence, and the post-subscription confirmation message. (3) If no consent evidence exists, the rebuttable presumption is that the subscriber did not agree to pay, so review the charges for a refund. (4) Confirm to the subscriber that the service is suspended and no further charges will accrue. (5) Aim to conclude the complaint within 20 business days.
